### Added
- The cluster-shape knobs default to `auto` and render by served API group (roadmap#4348, PRD Q4): `kyvernoPolicies.enabled` renders the Kyverno objects when `kyverno.io/v1` is served; `networkPolicy.flavor` is `cilium` when `cilium.io/v2` is served, else `kubernetes`; `global.observability.metrics.serviceMonitor.enabled` renders the monitor objects when `monitoring.coreos.com/v1` is served; `dicebear.route.enabled` (an Envoy `HTTPRouteFilter` user) follows `gateway.envoyproxy.io/v1alpha1`; `agentSandbox.podSecurity.enabled` (a Kyverno mutate policy) follows the resolved `kyvernoPolicies.enabled`. The meta chart detects once, from `.Capabilities.APIVersions` (live under helm-controller, the Helm CLI and `--dry-run=server`; Helm's built-in set under `helm template`, so an offline render without `--api-versions` yields the vanilla shape), resolves every knob before it inlines a component's values, and derives the component-level copies from the same answers while they are left at `auto`: `muster.networkPolicy.flavor`, `muster.muster.observability.metrics.prometheus.serviceMonitor.enabled` / `.prometheusRule.enabled`, `muster.muster.observability.grafanaDashboard.enabled`, `valkey.ciliumNetworkPolicy.enabled`, `valkey.valkey.metrics.podMonitor.enabled` (written `false` only where monitors are off), `kagent.otel.tracing.enabled` / `.logging.enabled`, `kagent.oauth2-proxy.metrics.serviceMonitor.enabled` and the `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_HEADERS` entry of `kagent.controller.env` (dropped when both OTel exporters are off). The connectivity chart carries the same defaults and the same resolution helpers (`agent-platform.shape.*`) for renders on its own; under the meta chart it receives resolved values, so the two cannot disagree on one cluster. Explicit `true` / `false` (`cilium` / `kubernetes`) values keep winning, on a knob and on a component copy; the schema accepts `auto|true|false` (`auto|cilium|kubernetes`) and rejects anything else; the connectivity chart's `.Capabilities` guards for the Flux and KServe APIs stay hard failures. `make verify-auto` (in CI) asserts the resolution per shape, the byte-identical fleet render, the vanilla shape and the overrides. **No installation needs to act**: with the fleet's API groups served the render is byte-identical to before; a kind or plain cloud cluster renders the vanilla shape from the same chart without a values file that describes it.
